new_fit_and_hiring: Use the prepared assessment/source, verify a source if useful, and contact with the relevant role or hiring campaign. Do not include the brand announcement or expose private numeric scores. No fresh evaluation is needed.
unrelated_news_only: Quiet completion; no email just for product/funding news, no irrelevant role, no fresh evaluation of the known non-fit.
already_notified: Quiet completion; do not repeat yesterday's same role/campaign or infer disinterest. No fresh evaluation.
minor_profile_change: Reuse the non-fit assessment and complete quietly. A spelling-only profile revision is no reason for automatic reevaluation.
